title: On the Word-Representability of Tensor Product Graphs
summary: Word-representable graphs are a class of graphs that can be represented by words, where edges and non-edges are determined by the alternation of letters in those words. The tensor product $G \times H$ (also known as the direct product or Kronecker product) is one of the four standard graph products. Problem 7.2.5 in Kitaev and Lozin's book \emph{Words and Graphs} (Springer, 2015) raised three open questions regarding the word-representability of tensor products.
